window.caveat: Scheduler slots and sampled receipts cannot establish full wallet or chain coverage, uninterrupted subscriptions, or profitable signals.

record.caveat: Sampled window evidence is not end-to-end on-chain collection proof. Provider registration, exact cohort, source receipts, archives and market outcomes require independent validation.

notes: Transaction-volume share measures webhook receipts, not unique independent traders or profitable trades.
Helius fee payer and token transfer/swap output hints are not independent verification of a buy or ownership.
Signed program invocation with owner token increases is not proof of a standalone swap, sellability or realized PnL.
USD MISSING_FUTURE quote coverage must be excluded from return statistics; never count it as zero or a loss.
Global recent JSON sampling can overrepresent busy wallets and must not be treated as a complete mint census.
No Helius RPC or DEX request, no wallet signing, no candidate auto-promotion, no scanner or paper changes.

limitations: Complete bounded 100-signature scan is not necessarily complete raw chain history.
Legacy GitHub live RPC cursors remain separate and unresolved.
Daily credit sums exclude other projects and are not Helius billing.
Partial or absent cron rows may hide executions that failed before D1 commit.
